criteria.description: check-release-graph.mjs asserts the attestation contract for both paths
criteria.evidence: checkAttestation + exact-step rule (pack, verify, report-dist-tags, publish-latest) + job hardening (NODE_AUTH_TOKEN only on exact registry-script runs; no token named in a run; persist-credentials; npx/npm exec pinned incl. `npm x` and pipes; verify signer/digest pins; no local actions; no auth line in the tracked .npmrc; no forged GITHUB_* env; no secret, `toJSON(secrets)` or `github.token` in any env value but NODE_AUTH_TOKEN and GH_TOKEN bound to exact key, value AND the verify step's exact run; no `npm dist-tag add`; no inline `npm publish` in any flag spelling — the last two applied to the rc payload only until gate pass 8) + publish-latest confined to release.yml's tag-triggered release job at gate and runtime + release.yml's trigger pinned to push tags ['v*.*.*'] + publishing capability DISCOVERED (privilege, credential in env or run text, npm publish/dist-tag, registry script, attest action) and held to two audited (workflow, job) pairs, over workflows, every local action a workflow uses (resolved by reference; an unresolvable one is refused) and every package manifest's npm scripts + no `scripts/…` token may be non-literal; 224 probes, each rule and each detection arm revert-tested red. Inside the audited jobs no step may put a credential in its run at all (a secret expansion as well as the variable name). Residual, recorded in the runbook and #471: a NEW secret handed to a third-party action through `with:` declares no privilege and appears in no run — and the capability signal itself rests on the repository's default workflow permission being `read` (measured).
criteria.notes: Static and local evidence; the first live attested publish is post-merge (T009).

criteria.description: The CycloneDX SBOM is still produced on both paths (its contents changed: see evidence)
criteria.evidence: Both workflows still run CycloneDX and the rc payload still uploads sbom-<dist-tag>. DEVIATION, recorded rather than glossed (gate pass 5 records fact-check): the tool was a release-time `npx @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm` fetch and is now an exact devDependency (6.0.1) run with `npx --no-install`, so the SBOM additionally lists that dev tree and the lockfile gained 122 dev entries. The pin was required by FR-005's hardening: an unpinned npx on a job holding id-token: write is a release-time fetch into the signing job. 'Unchanged' in the FR means the step and its artifact, not the byte content.
criteria.notes: Static and local evidence; the first live attested publish is post-merge (T009).
